testimonials.name: Zara Iskandar
testimonials.text: The Lotus Biscoff donut combined with their Signature Iced Latte is literally the only reason I survive late-night study sessions. The aesthetic is incredibly gorgeous!

testimonials.name: Farhan Danial
testimonials.text: Best dough texture in Shah Alam. Most donuts get dry, but Caah’s stays exceptionally soft even when bought for takeaway. 10/10 would recommend!

testimonials.name: Sarah Amina
testimonials.text: They treat donut-making like high art. The caramelization, the balance of sweetness, the chill late-night ambient playlist. It's a gorgeous escape.
